text:
claire: FYI rolled a small experimental change to the decode path this morning: combined sequence early-exit heuristics + opportunistic token compression. Early signal looks really promising: p50 -14%, p95 -21%, token infra cost projection -31% on sampled conv workloads. :tada:

jose: Nice! explain the two parts in one line each?

claire: Sure  early-exit = a cheap classifier that stops decoding when turn-level probability mass crosses a calibrated threshold for short replies; token compression = a lightweight delta/RLE encoder for sequences with repeated or stable softmax patterns to reduce network+RPC bytes. Both are conservative: classifier disabled for generation length > 256 and compression only applied to tokens that are losslessly reversible on decode.

perf-bot: Canary summary (canary id: early-exit-2026-11-08): requests 95,400, mix chat/completions 65/35, median seq 36, p50 44ms -> 38ms, p95 226ms -> 179ms, error rate unchanged 0.025% -> 0.025%. Dash: https://internal.redwood/perf/early-exit-2026-11-08

andre: Any impact on model quality or logits?

claire: We monitored NLU passthrough on the eval-set and human-quality buckets: no measurable degradation for the short-reply cohort. Compression is lossless; early-exit has a small tuned precision/recall tradeoff but we only enable it when the classifier confidence > 0.995 and sequence <= 64. Also added a fallback that forces full decode for failing QA prompts.

claire: Config snippet we used in canary:

```
decode:
  early_exit:
    enabled: true
    max_seq: 64
    conf_threshold: 0.995
    cooldown_ms: 120
  token_compression:
    enabled: true
    method: delta_rle
    min_repeats: 3
    max_compressed_bytes: 4096
    disable_on_encryption: true
```

jose: Host impact? regressions?

claire: Little to no extra CPU; actually lower overall host decode time due to shorter decodes on many requests. Network egress dropped ~22% on the canary hosts because of compression. We did add a small classifier compute op but it's cheap (vector lookup + tiny MLP).

eng-sre-bot: Canary -> rollout plan added: canary -> 3% -> 15% (6h) -> 60% (24h) -> 100% (48h). Auto-rollback triggers: p95 increase >4% OR error rate delta >0.12% OR any quality regression flagged by eval hooks. Alerts created in runbook.

deploy-bot: Rollout started at 1799001200, current rollout 3%.

jose: Great. Can we get a short 2-sentence blurb for the next all-hands? Ops/cost wins + a one-liner about safety controls.

claire: Will draft slides and a doc with the config+dash links. Adding a note to model-onboarding: early-exit may alter usual token distributions for short-turn tests.

andre: Follow-up: schedule a small A/B with a learned exit-policy (ML-based) vs the current heuristic next quarter.

claire: Added as spike to backlog. Closing thread  will post final rollout notes.
